Military Relocation · April Johnson

Real estate support for your Fort Benning military relocation

A move connected to military service comes with questions about timing, housing and what happens next. You may be buying from a distance, deciding what to do with a home you own or trying to coordinate several parts of a move.

I'm April Johnson, a U.S. Army veteran and Military Relocation Professional. I help buyers and sellers relocating to or from Fort Benning and surrounding communities.

Discuss my relocation ↗

Start with your timeline and your questions

Tell me when you expect to move, whether you need to buy or sell and which details are still uncertain. You do not need to share orders or sensitive service documents through a website form.

Buying during a relocation

Define the property requirements

Focus on the features you need, your preferred search areas and the locations you need to reach. Share any limits on when you can visit so we can discuss how to approach the search.

Bring financing questions to the right conversation

If you are considering VA financing, ask your lender about eligibility, costs and the requirements for your purchase. My role is to help with your real estate search and representation. Loan approval is not promised here.

Plan my home search around my move ↗

Selling before your next move

Share your expected departure timeframe and any questions about pricing or preparation. We can discuss a home-selling plan that accounts for the decisions you need to make. No particular sale date is guaranteed.

Compare the areas you want to consider

I serve Columbus, Phenix City, Smiths Station and other East Alabama and West Georgia communities. Use areas I serve to begin discussing locations. Bring the actual destinations and travel requirements you want to evaluate rather than relying on a general commute promise.

Make the next step manageable

Tell me what is confirmed and what could change. We can begin with the housing decision that needs attention first.

A question is a good place to start.

Tell me what you are considering and what you need to understand.

Have a question about your own situation?

Ask April ↗
Does April help with PCS moves to Fort Benning?

Yes. I help buyers and sellers relocating to or from Fort Benning and the surrounding communities.

What military relocation experience does April bring?

I am a U.S. Army veteran and hold the Military Relocation Professional certification. Communication and attention to detail are central to my approach.

Can I begin a home search before arriving in the area?

Yes. Start by sharing your preferred locations, property requirements and expected arrival timeframe. We can discuss how to approach the search and your availability.

Can I use a VA loan to buy a home near Fort Benning?

Discuss your eligibility and the specific purchase with a lender who handles VA financing. I can help with the real estate search, but I do not determine loan eligibility.

Can April help sell my home when I receive new orders?

Yes. Tell me about the property and your expected timing so we can discuss pricing, preparation and the selling process.

Let’s start with you

What would you like to do next?

Buying, selling, or working out how to do both. Bring your questions.
